title: Kerzenlicht
failed: The light did not start. See the Noctalia log
unsupported: This compositor cannot tell Kerzenlicht where the cursor is (missing {protocols})

flash_radius.label: Flash size
flash_radius.description: The glow a message or the flash key puts on the cursor, in logical pixels

flash_seconds.label: Flash length
flash_seconds.description: How long a flash from a message or the flash key stays, in seconds

dim.label: Dimming
dim.description: How dark shaking the mouse makes everything but the cursor, from 0.1 (a shade) to 0.9 (nearly black)

on_message.label: Flash for messages
on_message.description: Light the cursor when a notification comes in, except while Do Not Disturb is on

message_apps.label: Only these apps
message_apps.description: App names separated by commas, such as vesktop, telegram-desktop; empty flashes for every app

on_shake.label: Dim when shaking the mouse
on_shake.description: Shake the mouse six times left and right to dim everything but the cursor, for as long as you shake

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: The light around the cursor at full strength, in logical pixels

softness.label: Soft edge
softness.description: How many pixels the light takes to fade out

brightness.label: Brightness
brightness.description: How strong the white glow is, from 0.1 (a hint) to 1 (solid white, covering what is under it)

also_dnd.label: Also Do Not Disturb
also_dnd.description: Turn Do Not Disturb on with the glow, and put it back the way it was afterwards
